findings_qualitative.value: Fibers in the ISF are transonic, narrow, near hydrostatic equilibrium, and arranged in hub-like associations following the gravitational potential.

evidence.quote: The ISF fibers are spatially organized forming a dense bundle with multiple hub-like associations likely shaped by the local gravitational potential.

claims.hypothesis: The massive ISF is a bundle of fibers like low-mass filaments
claims.experiment: HiFIVE analysis of ALMA+IRAM N2H+ (1-0) mosaics
claims.result: 55 velocity-coherent fibers, 98% of dense gas mass
claims.finding: Fibers dominate the internal substructure of the ISF

evidence.quote: Using HiFIVE, we identify a total of 55 velocity-coherent elongated fibers along the ISF.

claims.hypothesis: ISF fibers have dynamical properties like low-mass fibers
claims.experiment: sigma_NT/c_s and M_lin versus critical mass
claims.finding: Fibers are transonic and near equilibrium

evidence.quote: The ISF fibers exhibit non-thermal velocity dispersions between 0.4 and 1.5 times their local sound speed.

claims.hypothesis: Filaments have a universal 0.1 pc width
claims.finding: ISF fibers are systematically narrower than 0.1 pc

evidence.quote: The ISF fibers show a median FWHM of 0.035 pc (blue dashed line) with 85% of the cuts showing FWHM values $<$ 0.050 pc

claims.hypothesis: Fiber surface density scales with cloud M_lin
claims.finding: Cluster formation as scaled-up concentration of fibers

evidence.quote: showing a surprising linear trend approximately described by a least-square fit $\Sigma(\mathrm{fertile})\sim 0.1\times M_\mathrm{lin}(\mathrm{total})$

why_this_data.value: N2H+ selectively traces high-density star-forming gas and has hyperfine structure enabling accurate kinematics

evidence.quote: N$_2$H$^+$ selectively highlights the high-density, star-forming material in compact regions

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Original FIVE with a single parameter set could not recover all structures in OMC-1 and OMC-2, so HiFIVE was created

evidence.quote: no single combination of \[$\nabla V_{lsr,0}$,I$_0$,N$_{friends}$\] values is able to satisfactorily recover all the structures

limitations_admitted.value: HiFIVE fails on the most complex structures (fibers 21, 36/37, 42/43); the 55 fibers are a simplified description

evidence.quote: the above 55 fibers should be interpreted as a simplified description of the real dense gas substructure within the ISF

limitations_admitted.value: Mass conversion uncertain by factor 2-3; lengths not corrected for projection

evidence.quote: Our length measurements do not consider projection effects making our M$_{\mathrm{lin}}$ values upper limits.
